title: Zelensky confirms the arrival of the first F-16 fighter jets in Ukraine
body:
On Sunday 4 August 2024 Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed in a speech that the first F-16 fighter jets had arrived in Ukraine. He thanked Denmark, the Netherlands and the United States for providing the aircraft. Novaya Gazeta Europe reported the confirmation on 5 August 2024.

According to The Economist, ten of the 79 F-16s promised by Ukraine's partners had arrived, ten more were expected before the end of 2024, and the remaining aircraft were due in batches during 2025. The announcement was made in Zelensky's speech marking the day of the Ukrainian Air Force. The United States had given the green light for NATO partners to transfer the jets in the summer of 2023.

Ukraine's commander-in-chief, Oleksandr Syrskyi, said the aircraft would help shoot down Russian missiles and aircraft. Zelensky did not state how many aircraft had arrived. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the jets would not be a magic bullet and would be shot down.
